context: Evaluates correct implementation of the Supabase Edge Function for processing multipart image uploads. Tests whether formData.get('files[]') is used, the file is converted to ArrayBuffer, exifr.parse(buffer, true) is called with full options, and CORS headers are included in all responses.
capability_tested: Server-side EXIF Extraction via Multipart Upload

checklist.name: formData.get('files[]')
checklist.description: The function calls req.formData() and then formData.get('files[]') using the exact field name Uppy sends.

checklist.name: String/missing file guard
checklist.description: The function checks that the extracted file is not null and not a plain string before proceeding, throwing an error otherwise.

checklist.name: ArrayBuffer conversion
checklist.description: file.arrayBuffer() is called to convert the uploaded file to a buffer before passing it to the parser.

checklist.name: exifr.parse with true
checklist.description: exifr.parse(buffer, true) is called with the second argument set to true to enable all parsing options.

checklist.name: Raw metadata as response body
checklist.description: The parsed metadata object is returned directly as the JSON response body (not wrapped in an additional property).

checklist.name: CORS headers in all responses
checklist.description: corsHeaders are spread into the headers of all Response objects, including error responses and the OPTIONS preflight response.
